newsitem.title: FRANCE: Robber killed, policeman hurt in French shootout.
newsitem.headline: Robber killed, policeman hurt in French shootout.

text.p: A bank robber was killed and two policemen were wounded in a shootout on Friday in the central French city of Lyon, police said.
The gunbattle broke out as the two robbers, in their 30s, left a branch of the Societe Generale bank with a haul of a few tens of thousands of francs (several thousand dollars).
A policeman was shot in the back and in the arm. A police chief suffered cuts from shattered glass. The other robber was detained.
